Definition: a Girgashite, one of the native tribes of Canaan
BiblicalUsage: Girgashite or Girgasite = "dwelling on a clayey soil"; 1) descendants of Canaan and one of the nations living east of the sea of Galilee when the Israelites entered the promised land
